newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sinochem awarded two Jan Dai Hung cargoes - sources.
newsitem.headline: Sinochem awarded two Jan Dai Hung cargoes - sources.

text.p: China's SINOCHEM has been awarded two 400,000-barrel cargoes of January Dai Hung crude in a tender at APPI Minas plus $1.00 and plus 95 cents respectively, traders said on Thursday.
The two cargoes are for lifting back-to-back January 15-20.
The Dai Hung field is offshore Vietnam and is operated by a consortium.

The consortium is made up by Australia's Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, with 43.75 percent, Malaysia's Petronas Carigali, 20 percent, state-owned PetroVietnam, 15 percent, Total SA and Sumitomo Corp, with 16.625 percent each.
Sources said the consortium had received seven bids in the tender, which closed earlier on Thursday.
